name: Should I hire one general contractor or manage individual trade repairs myself?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire one general contractor or manage individual trade repairs myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a single general contractor provides unified accountability, whereas managing separate trades yourself places scheduling, permits, and trade overlaps on your shoulders. Coordinated restoration requires careful sequencing: plumbing or electrical rough-ins must occur before insulation, followed by drywall, trim carpentry, tile, and final painting. When one contractor oversees the entire process and coordinates specialized sub-trades, there is no dispute between trades over delays, wall prep quality, or mismatched trim lines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a single general contractor ensures proper sequencing across trades, maintains a single point of accountability, and avoids trade coordination conflicts.
